title: Read task-sync snapshot and delta documents through the batched cat-file reader, not one Git process per document
outcome: Read task-sync snapshot and delta documents through the batched cat-file reader, not one Git process per document
acceptance: task_sync::git::delta::tests::snapshot::complete_cold_snapshot_reads_two_thousand_documents_and_keeps_unverified_envelope passes in a focused `cargo test --lib` run on Central (Windows), under the same -j1 and 4-thread load in which it failed in test-0018b7a5

delta::read_documents reads task document blobs through the existing batched `cat-file --batch` reader (Reader::blobs), so a cold snapshot or delta of N documents starts a number of Git processes that does not grow with N, keeping each blob's per-file limit and the total byte bound and refusing missing or oversized blobs with the same typed reasons
The test is not loosened, skipped or given a longer deadline
